input.summary: Add assignment mechanics: Company free assignment to affiliates/successors, HDI assignment only with our consent and never to a competitor, and no HDI termination right on our change of control.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 10.3 only addresses binding effect, so it leaves HDI free to assign the Agreement while giving us no express affiliate or M&A carve-out. We have added our standard assignment terms: we may assign to an affiliate or successor without consent, HDI may assign only with our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and never to a competitor, and a change of control of the Company gives HDI no termination right.

ops.text: The Company may assign this Agreement, without HDI's consent, to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets. HDI may not assign this Agreement without the Company's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, and may not in any event assign this Agreement to a competitor of the Company. A change of control of the Company shall not give HDI any right to terminate this Agreement.
